_meta.description: Wave 2 state-coverage fence baseline. minLoadingSegments is a FLOOR (only raise it, via --write-baseline, after adding new segment loading.tsx files — never lower it by hand). emptyStateGaps grandfathers list-shaped pages (OpFilterBar signal) with no EmptyState/OpCallout/`.length === 0` signal in their own directory; curing a gap lets its entry be removed — new gaps not in this list fail lint:states. 2026-07-22 manual audit: 14 of the original 17 baselined gaps were false positives caused by too-narrow signal detection (they already used the inline `.length === 0 ? <fallback/> : <list/>` idiom or OpCallout, not the LnEmptyState component name) — fixed by broadening EMPTY_STATE_SIGNAL_RE in check-state-coverage.ts, so those 14 no longer need a baseline entry at all. The remaining 3 are genuine structural blind spots, kept baselined: app/admin/alertas/page.tsx (empty message lives in components/admin/AlertInboxTable.tsx, a different directory — 'Sin alertas que coincidan con los filtros seleccionados.'); app/admin/casos/page.tsx (delegates to the shared components/ui/dashboard/CaseQueue.tsx, whose own emptyMessage prop renders 'Sin casos registrados para los filtros aplicados.' — also a different directory); app/gob/sistema/page.tsx (not actually list-shaped — a KPI/stats dashboard with no rows/table at all; it mounts OpFilterBar only for its period+jurisdiction controls, which mis-triggers the LIST_SIGNAL_RE heuristic).
